svg.title: Arndt Bohrenkämper: personal LCARS terminal
svg.desc: An original vector interpretation of a research shuttle with classic TNG-inspired proportions, shown in a detailed three-quarter view. A sculpted metallic cabin with rounded shoulders, a long dark cockpit windshield and angular side windows, recessed blue drive channels, service hatches and a forward sensor array sit within a dark exploration console. A visible star field surrounds the craft. Small status lights pulse slowly across several systems, with a few stars twinkling. Reduced-motion preferences disable all animation.
